badger.label: Badger
risks: The final ring pulls you out of your building. Know your exit before the last zone.
badger.note: Claim a building early and reinforce it.

ram.label: Ram
risks: Slow and committed once it starts. A Hawk catches you mid-siege.
ram.note: Take ground by force: crack setups instead of going round them.

hawk.label: Hawk
risks: A bad first push loses the momentum you live on.
hawk.note: Take space fast, over and over.

spider.label: Spider
risks: A porous position is exactly what a Ram punishes.
spider.note: Hold a strong spot and eat whatever wanders past.

wolf.label: Wolf
risks: Late rings squeeze the edge, with no position to fall back to.
wolf.note: Circle the edge and pick off stragglers.

fox.label: Fox
fox.note: Slip along the edge, avoid fights and outlast everyone.

noPlan.label: Dodo
noPlan.note: No clear plan. Pick one before you drop, or you'll wander into the first fight.
